title: 025 · Replacement for a lost parcel
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Aven Korrin, the recipient. From the case card: the carrier has completed its trace and confirmed DL-025 lost, the recipient has chosen a replacement, and only the merchant can approve and create it.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Pass the recipient's replacement choice to the merchant and get the merchant's confirmation of the replacement order.

recipient.name: Aven Korrin
recipient.responsibility: Choose between a replacement and a refund for the lost order.

loss_investigations.name: Loss investigations
loss_investigations.responsibility: Trace DL-025 and record the final loss finding.

merchant.name: Replacement authorisations
merchant.responsibility: Approve the replacement and create the replacement order.

goal: Get the merchant to approve the recipient's chosen replacement and confirm that the replacement order is created.
limits: Do not approve the replacement on the merchant's behalf; confirmed loss does not give the desk that authority.
Do not claim the replacement has been delivered.

intake.summary: DL-025 is confirmed lost: get the merchant to approve the recipient's chosen replacement.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: The parcel is lost and the merchant has not approved a replacement.

facts.text: The carrier has completed its trace and confirmed loss.
The recipient has chosen a replacement.
The merchant must approve and create the replacement.

success_criteria.description: The merchant has approved the recipient's chosen replacement.
The merchant has confirmed that the replacement order is created.

agent_state.next_action: Take in incoming information on the case.

steps.label: Carrier finding
steps.title: Carrier records DL-025 as confirmed lost
steps.explanation: The trace is complete and the loss is confirmed, but the finding does not create a replacement order. A replacement needs the merchant's approval.

facts_upsert.text: Final trace record INV-025: DL-025 could not be located after the completed depot and route search; carrier status is confirmed lost.
The loss finding does not itself create a merchant replacement order.

steps.label: Client choice
steps.title: Aven chooses a like-for-like replacement
steps.explanation: Aven chose a replacement over a refund and asked us to get the merchant's approval. Approval is the merchant's call, not ours, so we send the request to replacement authorisations.

facts_upsert.text: The recipient chooses a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund.
The recipient still needs the kettle from order TG-025.

decision.question: Replacement or refund for the lost kettle?
decision.reason: The recipient still needs the kettle.

annotations_add.title: What Aven knew before writing
annotations_add.text: Aven chooses a like-for-like replacement over a refund, so Aven already knows both remedies are possible. Who offered them is not recorded in the history.
